item.title: Vikings sign QB Kyler Murray a day after the 2019 first overall pick was cut by the Cardinals
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — The Minnesota Vikings signed quarterback Kyler Murray on Thursday, after focusing their latest search on the first overall pick from the 2019 NFL draft who was just released by the Arizona Cardinals.

item.title: Sepp Straka part of 4-way tie at the top at The Players Championship in wild weather
item.description: PONTE VEDRA BEACH, Fla. (AP) — Sepp Straka saved par seven times and chipped in for eagle late in his round Thursday while avoiding big trouble on the TPC Sawgrass for a 5-under 67 that gave him a share of the lead at The Players Championship amid wind, rain, sunshine and darkness.

item.title: Wilkes-Barre, Cancer Wellness Center of NEPA partner for inaugural Diamond City Shamrock 5K run, benefitting cancer patients
item.description: Wilkes-Barre’s Inaugural Diamond City Shamrock 5K run/walk will begin at 11 a.m. in front of the parade reviewing stand on Public Square.

item.title: Class 3A state swimming championships conclude
item.description: The PIAA Class 3A Swimming and Diving Championships wrapped up on Thursday, with three Wyoming Valley Conference swimmers in the pool for the second day of events at Bucknell University’s Kinney Natatorium.

item.title: H.S. Basketball: Four girls teams remain in state title hunt
item.description: From seven to six to four. That’s how the Wyoming Valley Conference has decreased entrants in the PIAA state basketball playoffs.

item.title: US military refueling plane crashes in Iraq and rescue is underway
item.description: WASHINGTON — An American military refueling plane taking part in the operation against Iran crashed in Iraq and rescue efforts were underway, U.S. Central Command said Thursday.

item.title: Grand marshal announced for Wilkes-Barre’s 46th annual St. Patrick’s Day Parade
item.description: Wilkes-Barre City Mayor George C. Brown announced last Friday that he selected retired Wilkes-Barre City Fire Department Assistant Chief William Murtha as the grand marshal of the city’s 46th St. Patrick’s Day Parade.

item.title: Opinion: Pa. never had a plan to prepare for data centers, now it needs a temporary statewide moratorium
item.description: Locally and across Pennsylvania, communities are being confronted with proposals for massive data centers… industrial, hyper-scale facilities that consume enormous amounts of electricity and water while permanently altering the landscape around them.

item.title: Diamonds & Coal: Celebrating spring and parades, jeering sinkholes and assault of state troopers
item.description: Diamonds to the Penn State Extension Master Gardeners of Wyoming County for hosting a free Community Seed and Plant Exchange, March 21, 10 a.m. to noon, at the Dietrich Theater in Tunkhannock. Gardeners at any level of green thumb (or even all thumb) are invited to share seeds and swap houseplants (pest and disease-free), open-house style. Master Gardeners will answer questions and present “tips for Healthy Houseplants” at 10:30 a.m. It’s a great idea we hope will, um, keep growing.
